caption: The drawing depicts a single object, a comb, positioned centrally against a plain, light beige background. The comb is rendered in shades of brown, with darker brown outlining and subtle variations indicating the grain and texture of what appears to be wood. The comb has a solid top section, which is decorated with a double-arched, openwork design featuring two curved openings and a central V-shaped extension. Below this section, three horizontal bands separate the top from the teeth of the comb. The teeth are long, tapering, and evenly spaced, extending downward in a straight line, with the tips terminating in points. The artist's signature, "K. Langweil Brown," is visible in small text to the lower right of the comb.
title: Comb (For Horses' Manes and Tails)
